approval.basis: User continued the female day editorial product breakdown and GitHub upload workflow with minimal looks.

copy.captionKo: 토프와 초콜릿 사이에 코발트 한 면.
copy.captionEn: One panel of cobalt between taupe and chocolate.
copy.captionDe: Eine Fläche Kobaltblau zwischen Taupe und Schokoladenbraun.
copy.introKo: 토프 코트를 열어 코발트 니트를 선명하게 보여줘요. 초콜릿 팬츠와 브라운 삭스, 다크 브라운 레이스업을 비슷한 농도로 맞추고 작은 코인 펜던트로 마무리해요.
copy.introEn: Open the taupe coat to show a clear panel of cobalt knit. Keep chocolate trousers, brown socks and dark lace-ups close in tone, finishing with a small coin pendant.
copy.introDe: Öffne den taupefarbenen Mantel über kräftigem Kobaltblau. Halte schokoladenbraune Hose, braune Socken und dunkle Schnürschuhe tonal nah beieinander und ergänze einen kleinen Münzanhänger.

products.descriptionKo: 앞을 열어 안쪽 레이어가 보이게 입어요. 소매와 밑단의 볼륨을 자연스럽게 남겨주세요.
products.descriptionEn: Wear it open to reveal the inner layers, keeping the natural volume of sleeves and hem.
products.descriptionDe: Trage die Jacke offen, damit die inneren Lagen sichtbar bleiben, und lasse Ärmeln und Saum ihr natürliches Volumen.
products.altKo: 토프 테일러드 코트 - 아이보리 배경의 개별 제품 컷
products.designDescriptionEn: warm taupe greige mid-length wool-look tailored overcoat, broad notched lapels, straight relaxed fit, tonal buttons, low welt pockets, dark taupe lining visible, hidden back conservative

products.descriptionKo: 코발트 니트를 단독 컬러 포인트로 둬요. 코트를 열어 앞면의 선명한 블루가 드러나게 해요.
products.descriptionEn: Use cobalt knit as the single bold colour and open the coat to reveal its blue front.
products.descriptionDe: Setze mit Kobaltblau den einzigen kräftigen Farbakzent und öffne den Mantel darüber.
products.altKo: 코발트 리브 니트 - 아이보리 배경의 개별 제품 컷
products.designDescriptionEn: vivid cobalt royal blue crewneck knit sweater, fine vertical rib-knit body, pronounced ribbed neck cuffs hem, plain no logos, hidden sleeves conservative

products.descriptionKo: 넉넉한 통을 접거나 조이지 않고 자연스럽게 떨어뜨려요. 상의 밑단을 정돈해 하의의 실루엣을 드러내요.
products.descriptionEn: Let the generous legs fall naturally and keep the top hem neat so the trouser shape stays visible.
products.descriptionDe: Lasse die weiten Beine natürlich fallen und ordne das Oberteil, damit die Form der Hose sichtbar bleibt.
products.altKo: 초콜릿 스트레이트 팬츠 - 아이보리 배경의 개별 제품 컷
products.designDescriptionEn: dark chocolate brown straight tailored trousers, center crease, ankle-length appearance in crouch but reconstruct normal full length without inventing details, concealed waistband conservative

products.descriptionKo: 팬츠와 신발 사이에 리브 조직을 짧게 드러내요. 발목에 과하게 뭉치지 않게 정리해요.
products.descriptionEn: Show a short section of ribbing between trousers and shoes without excessive bunching.
products.descriptionDe: Zeige zwischen Hose und Schuhen etwas Rippstruktur, ohne die Socken stark zu stauchen.
products.altKo: 브라운 리브 삭스 - 아이보리 배경의 개별 제품 컷
products.designDescriptionEn: matching pair medium chocolate brown heather ribbed crew socks, match visible ankle sock above lace-up shoes

products.descriptionKo: 팬츠와 양말의 브라운을 레이스업까지 이어줘요. 끈은 단정하게 묶어 앞코의 매끈함을 살려요.
products.descriptionEn: Continue the brown of trousers and socks into lace-ups, tying them neatly to keep the toe clean.
products.descriptionDe: Führe die Brauntöne von Hose und Socken in Schnürschuhen fort und binde die Senkel ordentlich.
products.altKo: 다크 브라운 레이스업 - 아이보리 배경의 개별 제품 컷
products.designDescriptionEn: matching pair dark brown polished leather-look low lace-up Oxford-style dress shoes, rounded almond toes with subtle toe-cap seam, brown laces, low stacked dark heels and dark soles

products.descriptionKo: 니트 위로 작은 펜던트만 드러내요. 가는 체인으로 목선의 레이어를 가볍게 이어줘요.
products.descriptionEn: Let the small pendant sit over the knit, keeping the neckline light with a fine chain.
products.descriptionDe: Lasse den kleinen Anhänger über dem Strick liegen und halte den Ausschnitt mit einer feinen Kette leicht.
products.altKo: 골드 톤 코인 네크리스 - 아이보리 배경의 개별 제품 컷
products.designDescriptionEn: ONE delicate fine gold-tone necklace with very small round coin pendant, visible on cobalt knit, full chain conservative

products.descriptionKo: 작은 후프로 얼굴 가까이에 은은한 포인트를 더해요. 목걸이와 비슷한 금속 톤으로 정리해요.
products.descriptionEn: Add a subtle accent near the face with small earrings, keeping the metal tone coordinated.
products.descriptionDe: Setze mit kleinen Ohrringen einen dezenten Akzent am Gesicht und stimme den Metallton ab.
products.altKo: 미니 골드 이어링 - 아이보리 배경의 개별 제품 컷
products.designDescriptionEn: ONE matching pair tiny understated gold-tone small huggie earrings based on the partially visible small earlobe detail, no extra decoration, hidden clasp conservative

reconstructionNotes: Hidden backs, linings, waistbands, shirt/sweater bodies and opposite footwear are conservative reconstructions.
Jewelry backs, posts and clasps are inferred; actual metal composition is unknown.
Material names describe visual appearance, not verified composition or performance.
Exact actual and feels-like temperature values are unknown; Chilly is grounded in the source folder.
excludedItems: Food, drinks, crockery, paper grocery bags and groceries are scene props, excluded from outfit products.
